title: Unit front-matter
description: Contract for front-matter of every unit file (index/activities/formative/summative/teacher-notes). Required fields gate the build (FR-009, SC-007); optional fields are shape-checked only when present. Answer-key fields are forbidden (FR-012).

course_code.description: Must match parent course folder (uppercased). Placeholder codes like EFPC-4-- permitted while pending.

clo_refs.description: SLO-format outcome references 'SLO:<course-code>-<unit-no>-<n>' (e.g. SLO:EFMP-301-1-2). Field key stays 'clo_refs' per Constitution II.2; values are SLO refs.

coming_soon.description: true for scaffolded/un-authored units -> rendered 'coming soon' (SC-005).

resources.description: Reading materials / recommended books - cited only, never reproduced (Constitution III.5).

assessment_weighting.description: Default {summative:60, formative:40} (GECEs, Constitution III.7). Must sum to 100 - enforced by a custom validator check.

assessment_weighting_note.description: Justification for any per-unit deviation from the default 60/40 split (FR-010). Required in practice whenever assessment_weighting is not {60,40}; shape-checked when present.
